experiments.title: Structured Memory Handoff Test
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit structured project memory improves handoff fidelity over a flat baseline without increasing critical fabrications.
experiments.metric: PCRB-1 score, paired delta and critical fabrication count
experiments.acceptance_rule: Pilot: three paired trials and mean structured improvement >= 10 with lower 95% bound > 5; final adoption additionally requires nine paired trials, model/provider diversity, holdout, calibration and regression pass.
experiments.notes: Pilot adjudicated REJECT on a critical fabrication confirmed by two evaluators (2026-09-16). Its +24.2 gap is not evidence about structure: the two states carried different facts and the structured state leaked its condition label. See PILOT_DESIGN_FLAWS.md. Superseded by PROP-EXP-MEM-002.

experiments.title: Independent Evaluator Reliability Test
experiments.hypothesis: Two evaluator models from different providers can score the same blinded outputs with bounded disagreement and explicit fabrication reconciliation.
experiments.metric: within-pair absolute score difference, fabrication agreement and calibration pass rate
experiments.acceptance_rule: At least two independent evaluators, disagreement <= 15 points on every pair, no unresolved calibration failure, and no unconfirmed fabrication treated as a rejection.
experiments.notes: This is registered as proposed; it has not been run.

experiments.title: Canonical State Regression Preservation
experiments.hypothesis: A candidate memory or evaluator change can improve the target metric without degrading mission reconstruction, failure preservation or next-action fidelity.
experiments.metric: fixed regression scorecard across multiple capabilities
experiments.acceptance_rule: Every registered capability meets its minimum threshold; any failed capability vetoes final adoption.
experiments.notes: Failure vetoes the candidate; it does not silently rewrite canonical history.

experiments.title: Structure-only Memory Handoff Test
experiments.hypothesis: Holding information content constant, a sectioned project state improves blind handoff fidelity over the same facts in prose, without increasing critical fabrications.
experiments.metric: PCRB-1 score, paired delta and critical fabrication count
experiments.acceptance_rule: V4 gate, pilot stage: nine paired trials, single generator identity; best outcome PROVISIONAL_KEEP.
experiments.notes: Adjudicated REJECT on 2026-09-16: one critical fabrication confirmed in each condition. Hypothesis not supported: structured scored lower for both scorers (-4.4 and -2.1 mean paired delta, not significant). See RESULT.md. Followed by PROP-EXP-MEM-003.

experiments.title: Structure-only Handoff with a Capable Generator
experiments.hypothesis: Holding information content constant, a sectioned project state improves blind handoff fidelity over the same facts in prose, without increasing critical fabrications, for a capable hosted generator.
experiments.metric: PCRB-2 score (components only, totals computed), paired delta and confirmed critical fabrications per condition
experiments.acceptance_rule: V4 gate, pilot stage, ADR-004 options: thirty pairs; REJECT if structured has more confirmed fabrications, mean improvement < 10 or lower 95% bound <= 5; INCONCLUSIVE if scorers disagree by > 15 on more than 20% of pairs; best outcome PROVISIONAL_KEEP.
experiments.notes: Same inputs as MEM-002; generator qwen/qwen3.8-27b on Groq; pre-registered scorer and checker ladders; runs unattended through scripts/run_experiment.py.
